item.title: ⛑ 'Thank you for saving my dad', such letters are more significant for military medics than any awards.
item.description: 'Thank you for saving my dad', such letters are more significant for military medics than any awards. ⛑ Doctors of the forward medical group of the 74th Separate Guards Motorised Rifle Brigade (Tsentr Group of Forces) save the servicemen's lives in Dnepropetrovsk direction. In a forward hospital, the wounded servicemen are given first aid, operated and escorted during evacuation to the rear area. 🫶 They are treated not only with medicines, but also with people's warmth. ‘We don't care whether a serviceman has minor or moderate injury, I send every doctor with him to talk to him, to cheer him up. This factor really supports the servicemen,’ says Mamadi Gadzhiyev, the medical company commander. 💌 The most valuable reward for medics are children's letters of gratitude for saving their fathers and random meetings with their patients already in peaceful life, on vacation. Thank you for your hard work, Guardian Angels! ❤️‍🩹 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:

Thank you for your hard work, Guardian Angels!

item.title: 💬 Breaking through enemy's defence A platoon commander with the call sign ‘Dok’ told about the neutralisation of the enemy
item.description: Breaking through enemy's defence 💬 A platoon commander with the call sign ‘Dok’ told about the neutralisation of the enemy near Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. 💥 His artillery crews in close cooperation with air reconnaissance units support infantry offensives and methodically break through the enemy's echeloned defences. They hit enemy UAV launch sites and manpower near Druzhkovka. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at power and fuel infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at power and fuel infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result, the following targets were hit: ▫️ a 110 kV power substation providing operation of the defence industry facilities of Ukraine in the settlement Priluki (Chernigov region); ▫️ a dry cargo ship at sea delivering military cargo south-west of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📆 Top News Today Crushing the enemy's rear: delivered strikes against power facilities
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🎯 Crushing the enemy's rear: delivered strikes against power facilities , logistics and port infrastructure, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 🤝 Road to life: the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen evacuated nine civilians from Konstantinovka. One of the rescued residents of Konstantinovka described the cruelty of Ukrainian nationalists. ▫️ Taken aback : the Vostok Group's assaultmen mopped up an AFU stronghold in Zaporozhye region. 🔥 Flattened the shack : the Yuzhnaya Group's drone operators of the 85th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade obliterated the AFU UAV control posts in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. 💥 A deadly 'surprise' for the enemy : the Tsentr Group's EOD specialists eliminated the AFU infantry by means of remote mining. 🎮 Had a ride – that's enough : UAV operators of the Vostok Group of Forces disrupted an AFU rotation in Zaporozhye region. The day is done, the tasks are completed. We keep working ▫️ #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
